  Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A W →

∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (V : Type u_3) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} V] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k V]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_3} A V] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k A V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_3} k V],
  Exists.{1} fun n =>
    Exists.{u_3 + 1} fun W =>
      And
        (∀ (i : Fin n),
          Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W i) x))
        (And (Eq.{u_3 + 1} (iSup.{u_3, 1} W) Top.top.{u_3}) (iSupIndep.{1, u_3} W))

∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (V : Type u_3) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} V] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k V]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_3} A V] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k A V] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_3} k V] {n m : Nat}
  (W : Fin n → Submodule.{u_2, u_3} A V) (W' : Fin m → Submodule.{u_2, u_3} A V),
  (∀ (i : Fin n),
      Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W i) x)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin m),
        Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W' i) x)) →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), Ne.{u_3 + 1} (W i) Bot.bot.{u_3}) →
        (∀ (i : Fin m), Ne.{u_3 + 1} (W' i) Bot.bot.{u_3}) →
          Eq.{u_3 + 1} (iSup.{u_3, 1} W) Top.top.{u_3} →
            iSupIndep.{1, u_3} W →
              Eq.{u_3 + 1} (iSup.{u_3, 1} W') Top.top.{u_3} →
                iSupIndep.{1, u_3} W' →
                  And (Eq.{1} n m)
                    (Exists.{1} fun σ =>
                      ∀ (i : Fin n),
                        Nonempty.{u_3 + 1}
                          (LinearEquiv.{u_2, u_2, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A)
                            (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W i) x)
                            (Subtype.{u_3 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_3, u_3} (W' (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} σ i)) x)))

∀ (k : Type u_1) (A : Type u_2) (W : Type u_3) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Ring.{u_2} A]
  [inst_2 : Algebra.{u_1, u_2} k A] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} W] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k W]
  [inst_5 : Module.{u_2, u_3} A W] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k A W] [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_3} k W],
  Etingof.IsIndecomposable.{u_2, u_3} A W →
    ∀ {n : Nat} (θ : Fin n → LinearMap.{u_2, u_2, u_3, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_2} A) W W),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), IsNilpotent.{u_3} (θ i)) → IsNilpotent.{u_3} (Finset.sum.{0, u_3} Finset.univ.{0} fun i => θ i)
